remarks: Introducing the Alder by Justin Gray Homes, w/ NEW interiors professionally designed by CM Interior Designs. This 2,971 sq. ft. walkout is situated on a 36-pocket lot BACKING THE RAVINE & features a ATTACHED TRIPLE-CAR GARAGE. The main floor showcases 12ft ceilings through the kitchen, dining area & great room, hardwood flooring, a private den w/ stained doors, mudroom & walk-through pantry. The chef-inspired kitchen features an upgraded built-in professional-grade SS appliance package, including a full-size fridge/freezer combo, wall oven & microwave, plus a large central island overlooking the great room w/ fireplace. Upstairs offers 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, a generous bonus room & convenient laundry. The primary retreat includes a spa-inspired 5-piece ensuite & large walk-in closet. Additional highlights include the NEW Bronze Reverie interior palette, Timbermasters beams in the vaulted primary bedroom & bonus room, flat painted ceilings & 200-amp service! Mins to all major amenities, parks & schools! (id:67522)
